stack: Static web app (HTML/JS ES modules), node:test, GitHub Pages

features.name: Increase the number of user by adding…

idea.intent: Travellers planning a trip get a ready-to-use checklist by picking suggestions from the 'Guides' they already read, so more people start and keep using the app for trip planning.
idea.problem: Guides hold useful suggestions (what to prepare, bring, or do), but today a traveller has to retype them into the trip's checklist by hand. That extra work puts people off, and nobody can see whether Guides help people plan, so we can't tell if they bring in or keep users.
users: Traveller / trip owner who builds the trip checklist
Trip members who tick items on the shared checklist
Admin who wants to see whether Guides drive adoption
idea.outcomeMetric: A traveller can add a suggestion from a Guide to a trip's checklist in one step and see it on the checklist straight away. Admin can see how many Guide suggestions travellers add to checklists, so the team can tell whether the feature brings in and keeps users. No target is set yet; one will be agreed after a few weeks of real usage data.
scopeIn: Add a suggestion from a Guide to a chosen trip's checklist
Confirmation when a suggestion is added, and a clear error when it cannot be added
Counting how often Guide suggestions are added to checklists, visible to Admin
scopeOut: Changing how checklists are shared or ticked by trip members
risks: The need says 'increase the number of user', which is unclear. It may mean more app users, or more travellers on a trip. The Product Owner should confirm before design starts.
No success metric or baseline exists yet. Pick one metric and set the target only after a few weeks of real data.
Usage counting must not expose personal data about individual travellers.
Adoption: travellers may not find the 'add to checklist' action inside Guides.
Duplicate items if the same suggestion is added twice to one checklist.
idea.need: Increase the number of user by adding some suggestion from 'Guides' into trip's checklist

design.summary: REQ-002 is a cross-cutting baseline, so it gets no new page. The design adds three things on top of the existing app. (1) A shared focus and keyboard layer on the existing shell, pages and `Modal`. (2) A fast-start Home page that reuses the lazy-loading approach already in REQ-011. (3) The F-001 'Add suggestion to checklist' dialog, built to the baseline so TC-003 and TC-004 can be checked on a real form. It reuses `Modal`, `Combobox`, the `.btn` and `.field` styles and the toast via `notify`. Page CSS stays split per page (`src/styles/pages/`) [S4 agent-knowledge]. Nothing new is added to the first load.
design.notes:
Accessibility:
- Target is WCAG 2.1 AA: text contrast 4.5:1, focus ring and icon contrast 3:1, touch targets at least 44x44 px on phones.
- Texts must exist in both VI and EN (`src/i18n.jsx`, `src/i18n-en.js`). Check that the aria-labels and error messages are translated, not hard-coded.
- Automated check for TC-003: a keyboard-only Tab walk through each page, plus an axe scan. TC-004 is manual: submit the dialog with no trip chosen and confirm the error and that nothing is saved.

Responsive (phone):
- The dialog uses the existing Modal, with `modal--sm` on narrow screens. The controls stack full-width.
- The bottom nav must not cover the focused field. Scroll the focused element into view.
- The virtual keyboard must not hide the error or the Add button.
- The skip link and focus ring must also work with an external keyboard on a tablet.

Open questions:
1. Is the 2.5 s target for the home page only, or also for Guides? The requirement says home page only.
2. Should the 'Add to checklist' button show only to signed-in users? Per the FAQ, creating trips needs a Google sign-in.
3. The Combobox and Modal are read only in part (snippets). Confirm which focus-trap and focus-return behaviour already exists before changing them.
4. The ideas notes say 'increase the number of user' is unclear (more app users or more trip members). The Product Owner should confirm. This does not change the REQ-002 screens.
5. The dialog and the Guides button come from other F-001 requirements. They are shown here only to apply REQ-002 and need to be linked to those requirements' own screens.

screens.name: Keyboard and focus baseline (all pages)
screens.purpose: Every page in the app can be used with the keyboard alone. Every interactive element is reachable and shows a clear focus ring. Screen readers get landmarks and names.
elements: 'Skip to main content' link, the first tab stop on every page, visible only on focus
Landmarks: header/nav, main, and the bottom nav on phones labelled with aria-label
One global :focus-visible style with a high-contrast ring (at least 3:1 against the background) on buttons, links, icon-buttons, inputs and the Combobox. No outline:none without a replacement
Icon-only controls (✕, ✏️, 🗑️, 📅) keep an aria-label. Fix any that lack one, e.g. the Combobox clear button has a hard-coded 'Clear'. Use t() instead
Logical tab order that follows reading order. Custom clickable divs become real <button>/<a> or get role, tabIndex and Enter/Space handlers

Existing Modal: keeps role=dialog, aria-modal and Escape to close. Add focus moved into the dialog on open, focus kept inside while open, and focus returned to the trigger on close. This was not visible in the code read
Status messages (toasts) use role=status / aria-live=polite. Errors use role=alert
Colour is never the only signal. The due-today (yellow) and overdue (red) checklist states also carry text or an icon
states: Default: no visible ring on mouse clicks, ring on keyboard focus
Focused: visible ring on every control
Modal open: focus trapped, Escape closes, focus returns to the opener
Error: message linked to its field with aria-describedby and announced
Reduced motion: transitions and animations are off when prefers-reduced-motion is set

screens.name: Home page fast start (4G)
screens.purpose: The home page becomes interactive within 2.5 s on a 4G connection (Lighthouse), with nothing heavy loaded before it is needed.
elements: Reuse the REQ-011 lazy loading: map libraries, country borders, the English dictionary and heavy studios are loaded only when needed
Non-blocking CSS, split per page, and a small critical shell that paints first
Images with width/height set and lazy loading below the fold, so layout does not shift
Skeleton or Loader (existing ui Loader) for content that arrives late, with aria-busy on the region
The 'Add to checklist' code from F-001 is lazy-loaded with the Guides page or dialog, not in the home bundle
The performance check is a Lighthouse mobile 4G run on the home page with Time to Interactive/TBT under budget
states: Loading: shell and skeleton shown, controls already focusable
Slow or offline network: content that did not load shows a short message with a Retry button, and the rest of the page still works
Error: a failed lazy chunk shows a retry message instead of a blank screen

screens.name: Add suggestion to checklist dialog (F-001, built to the baseline)
screens.purpose: A traveller picks a Guide suggestion and a trip, and adds it to that trip's checklist entirely by keyboard. It is the real form where TC-004 is checked: invalid input shows an error and saves nothing.
elements: Opened from an 'Add to checklist' button on each Guide suggestion, a real <button> with an accessible name that includes the suggestion text
Existing Modal with title 'Add to checklist'
Read-only line showing the suggestion text
Trip selector: existing Combobox, with a visible <label>, role=combobox, and arrow/Enter/Escape keys
Primary button 'Add' and secondary 'Cancel', with the existing .btn styles. Enter submits
Inline error text under the trip field, red and with an icon, with role=alert and linked by aria-describedby
Toast on success through notify(), announced by a screen reader
states: Default: focus lands on the trip selector. If the user has only one trip it is preselected and focus goes to 'Add'
Empty: the user has no trips. The dialog explains this and offers 'Create a trip', and Add is not offered
Invalid input: no trip chosen. Show 'Choose a trip first', keep focus on the trip field, save nothing
Loading: while saving, the existing Loader replaces the buttons and the dialog stays open
Success: confirmation toast and the dialog closes. Focus returns to the 'Add to checklist' button
Error: saving failed or offline. Show 'Could not add this item. Try again' in the dialog, nothing is saved, and the user can retry
Duplicate: the item is already on that checklist. Show a message and do not add it twice

requirements.title: Accessibility and performance baseline
requirements.story: As an user, I want every page to work with keyboard and screen readers and load quickly, so that everyone can use the product.
ac:
Given any page
When I navigate with the keyboard only
Then every action is reachable and has a visible focus state

Given a 4G connection
When I open the home page
Then it becomes interactive within 2.5 seconds (Lighthouse)

requirements.title: Add a Guide suggestion to a trip checklist in one step
requirements.story: As a traveller who owns a trip, I want to add a suggestion I read in a Guide to my trip's checklist with one action, so that I don't retype it by hand.
ac: Given I view a Guide suggestion and have a trip selected · When I activate 'Add to checklist' once · Then a new unticked checklist item with the suggestion's text appears on that trip's checklist without a page reload

Given the suggestion text is longer than the checklist item limit of 120 characters (CHECK_ITEM_MAX in src/lib/checklist.js) · When I add it · Then the item is saved truncated to 120 characters and the add succeeds
Given I add a suggestion · When trip members open the shared checklist · Then they see the new item with the same tick behaviour as any other item

requirements.title: Choose which trip receives the suggestion
requirements.story: As a traveller with several trips, I want to pick the trip a suggestion goes to, so that it lands on the right checklist.
ac: Given I own two or more trips · When I activate 'Add to checklist' on a suggestion · Then I am asked to choose a trip before anything is saved, and the item is added only to the chosen trip
Given I have no trip yet · When I activate 'Add to checklist' · Then I see a message that I need a trip first with an action to create one, and no item is saved
Given I am only a member (not owner) of a trip and the app does not let me edit that trip's checklist · When the trip list is shown · Then that trip is not offered as a target

requirements.title: Block duplicate Guide suggestions on one checklist
requirements.story: As a traveller, I want the app to stop me adding the same Guide suggestion twice to one trip, so that my checklist has no repeated items.
ac: Given a trip's checklist already contains an item added from suggestion X · When I add suggestion X to the same trip again · Then no second item is created and I see a message that it is already on the checklist
Given suggestion X is already on trip A's checklist · When I add suggestion X to trip B · Then the item is added to trip B
Given I renamed the item that came from suggestion X · When I add suggestion X to the same trip again · Then it is still treated as a duplicate

requirements.title: Confirmation and clear error when adding a suggestion
requirements.story: As a traveller, I want to be told whether my suggestion was added or why it failed, so that I know the state of my checklist.
ac: Given the add succeeds · When the item is saved · Then I see a confirmation naming the trip within the same screen and the suggestion's action changes to an 'Added' state

Given the add cannot be saved (for example the device is offline or the save is rejected) · When I activate 'Add to checklist' · Then I see an error message that states the item was not added and what I can do next, and no item appears on the checklist
Given an error occurred · When I activate 'Add to checklist' again after the cause is fixed · Then the item is added once

requirements.title: Admin sees how many Guide suggestions are added to checklists
requirements.story: As an Admin, I want to see how many Guide suggestions travellers add to checklists, so that the team can tell whether Guides help people plan and keep using the app.
ac: Given travellers have added Guide suggestions · When an Admin opens Insights · Then the total number of suggestions added is shown for a selectable period (last 7 days, last 30 days, all time)
Given a suggestion add is blocked as a duplicate or fails with an error · When the count is calculated · Then that attempt is not counted
Given a user without Insights permission · When they open the admin area · Then they cannot see the count

requirements.title: Admin count by Guide without personal data
requirements.story: As an Admin, I want the count broken down by Guide while hiding who added what, so that we learn which Guides work without exposing individual travellers.
ac: Given suggestions were added from several Guides · When an Admin views the count · Then each Guide is listed with its number of adds
Given the stored count data · When it is inspected or exported · Then it contains no user id, name, email or trip id, only Guide, date and count
Given a Guide has no adds in the period · When the Admin views the list · Then that Guide is shown with a count of 0

requirements.title: Make 'Add to checklist' visible on every Guide suggestion
requirements.story: As a traveller reading a Guide, I want to see the 'Add to checklist' action next to each suggestion, so that I find it without searching.
ac: Given I open a Guide that has suggestions · When the page loads · Then each suggestion shows an 'Add to checklist' action without opening any menu

Given I use only a keyboard or a screen reader · When I move through a suggestion · Then the action can be reached and activated by keyboard and has an accessible name that includes the suggestion text (REQ-025 baseline)
